content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The revert is where the write half meets undo and redo; the gate forces the selective revert to answer to both legs without re-deciding granularity. It covers the recording leg's journal apply (S3-journal-apply, omwrpwpq): a recording is inverted by applying its entry, while a creation and a removal use the change-level inverse.
